notes.title: Stunning new indie puzzler is channeling Shadow of the Colossus
notes.content:
If stylish comic book-inspired visuals, journeys through long-forgotten lands, and ethereal soundtracks are your kind of thing, this new indie game from Belgian developer Badass Mongoose could be right up your street. In Helix: Descent n Ascent, you'll travel a nonlinear path filled with puzzles, using five special abilities to help you solve them. You'll also look for hints about what happened in this ancient world.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Helix: Descent N Ascent - Reveal Trailer
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=PX7mrM-ZQ_8;full][/previewyoutube]

In Helix: Descent N Ascent, you are what remains of your own kind. Many questions will arise and the answers lie before you. Use your unique powers, and combine them, in a unique monochromatic puzzle games that will take you to the edge of existence. 

Track the hints, rebuild forgotten memories, make your way to the path of knowledge, and tame this strange and mezmerizing world. Through this melancholic adventure, you may find answers but also an unexpected companion. How far will you go to unravel these answers? 

Set to be released in 2025, Helix: Descent N Ascent offers a unique level design, multiple gameplay options, an atmospheric and haunting soundtrack. It will be available on Steam and Nintendo Switch.
